critical_code_review_comments: routes/marketplace_products.py:238-250 award-on-delivered — merchant_bigpoint_accounts $inc happens BEFORE points_awarded_done is set. If the second update_one fails, the merchant's prepaid balance is decremented AND the buyer got points, but the flag remains false, so a subsequent PATCH to 'delivered' will re-run the award (won't award points again due to idempotency_key, but WILL decrement merchant balance again). Move the merchant decrement AFTER points_awarded_done is written, or wrap both in idempotency check.
routes/marketplace_products.py:227-237 product_shipped notification — swallows ALL exceptions silently. If the notifications collection is broken, no visibility. Log at least a warning.

routes/marketplace_products.py:359-367 gift-card auto-apply — same class of race condition documented in iter57 for menu orders: gift-card is reserved in order.gift_card_applied_cents when Stripe session is created, but only DEBITED on payment success. Concurrent orders can double-reserve the same balance. Consider a soft-hold pattern.

routes/marketplace_products.py:454-482 product_order_status — polls Stripe on every GET when payment_status!=paid. No throttle. A refreshing client can hammer stripe.Session.retrieve. Add 5s in-memory throttle keyed by session_id (same finding as iter57).

services/loyalty.py:69-89 award_with_tier_bonus — computes tier AFTER awarding base points. Correct semantics, but if a single order pushes lifetime across a tier boundary, the bonus % applied is the NEW tier's (higher) — potentially surprising for the merchant. Document this intended behavior.

routes/marketplace_products.py:262 projection includes 'happy_hour' — good (avoids the iter57 bug for /menu). Same pattern should be applied consistently — /businesses/{id}/services should also include happy_hour in its projection if consumer surface reads points_multiplier from it.

routes/marketplace_products.py:194-202 _restock on cancel — restocks even for gift-card-only ($0) orders where stock was decremented in _decrement_stock. Correct. But for Stripe-paid orders where the session is abandoned (never paid), stock is decremented ONLY on product_order_status's first paid-confirmation branch (lines 468-475), NOT on checkout. Verify no double-decrement path exists.
Loyalty tiers stored client-hardcoded (services/loyalty.py:13-25). If ops wants to tune thresholds/pct, code deploy required. Consider moving to a config collection.
